messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: ingress-controller (envoy) 5xx surge detected in eastus-a. spike started ~1918123400. high error-rate and connection resets observed. auto-pager triggered.

pagerduty: Paging oncall: @akshat-sre (SRE oncall). Severity: Sev2. Service: ingress-proxy-eastus.

akshat: on it. joining. seeing a big queue depth on envoy upstreams, lots of 502/503s and resets.

maria: adding logs from ingress: `2026-03-15T11:57:02Z envoy [error] upstream reset while reading response` and `503 connection terminated by upstream`.

rohit: metrics show 95th latency increase and request queue length for pod ingress-5 is saturating. Could be upstream node flapping behind ALB target group.

dave: checking ALB target health - multiple targets in eastus-a marked unhealthy around 11:56. healthcheck failures: TCP RST.

akshat: initial plan: 1) fail traffic away from eastus-a via weighted DNS routing to eastus-b 2) scale ingress replica count in eastus-a 3) rotate nodes in eastus-a if targets keep failing.

carla: customer-impact: CS reported a subset of customers in eastus experiencing timeouts for embeddings and chat. tagging affected accounts list_A (short list).

maria: quick commands I'm running: ```kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=ingress -o wide``` shows pods on 3 nodes, pod ingress-5 shows RESTARTS 2, CPU spike.

rohit: ingress config note: we recently enabled conn_idle_timeout=30s in envoy. suspecting connection churn + ephemeral keepalives causing resets under load.

dave: I manually set ALB target-group deregistration delay to 10s for quick failover and forced a re-register on healthy targets in eastus-b to pick up extra traffic.

akshat: I'm going to temporarily shift 60% of EastUS traffic to eastus-b via Route53 weighted policy (TTL 60). Doing change now, ETA 30s to propagate.

deploy-bot: Route53 change applied by akshat (change-id: C111222).

maria: scaled ingress replicas from 3 -> 8 in eastus-a: `kubectl -n infra scale deploy/ingress --replicas=8 --context=cluster-eastus-a` to soak queue.

rohit: also enabling Envoy upstream keepalive and increasing max_concurrent_streams from 100 -> 500 for the ephemeral target pool. Applying config patch to ingress configmap.```yaml
# patch excerpt
upstream:
  http2_max_concurrent_streams: 500
  keepalive: true
```

akshat: after weighted shift and scaling, 5xx rate dropped from 12% -> 2% in eastus-a over last 2m. Connection resets decreased. Good signal.

carla: still seeing some slow requests for a handful of customers — CS is notifying them and offering failover guidance.

dave: network side: AWS reported an AZ-level network backend issue affecting a subset of instances in eastus-a between 11:55-12:05. We're filing for followup with AWS.

maria: creating a temporary traffic-split runbook note in the incident doc for next responders: `if ALB target unhealthy > 30% then shift 50-80% weight to eastus-b, scale ingress to N, enable keepalive patch.`

akshat: handing off to morning oncall @rohit for post-incident checks and writeup. I'll stay for 10m if needed.

rohit: acknowledged handoff. next steps: 1) let weighted DNS run for 30m with TTL 60 2) monitor target health and drain any remaining unhealthy targets 3) gather HPA and pod OOM/restart causes 4) follow up with AWS ticket and update postmortem.

deploy-bot: Incident annotation added to service: ingress-proxy-eastus, incident_id=INC-20260315-42.

akshat: marking as mitigated for customer-facing purposes. moving to monitoring state. :white_check_mark:

carla: CS notified customers via status page and sent followup to priority 1 customers.

rohit: I'll create a short postmortem draft and include action items: roll back aggressive keepalive, add ALB healthcheck scrutiny, add runbook step to adjust Route53 weights automatically, and look into node-level NIC driver patches.

maria: adding log snippets and graphs to the incident doc.

akshat: thanks team. handing completely to @rohit. closing paging.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> monitoring. severity downgraded to SEV3.

rohit: (note) last message: 5xx rate stable at ~1-2% in eastus-a, weighted routing still at 60% eastus-b. will keep open until 12:30 and then start recovery to default weights if healthy.

carla: leaving a CS followup checklist in the doc.

-- end of thread --
